# xagent-trading-bot

> Paper trading on branch `staging` (Railway env test). `main` is live — Jens only. Agent instructions live in AGENTS.md.

This file is an agent index (llms.txt). Prefer linked Markdown over guessing.

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): mandatory operating rules, merge/review, Omnigent + Hindsight
- [docs/workflow.md](workflow.md): roles, branch flow, evidence

- [docs/release-framework.md](release-framework.md): version gate (blocked), slices, no strategy GO
- [docs/releases/2026-11-plan.md](releases/2026-11-plan.md): 8–22 November decision slots and board views 9, 10, 11
- [docs/releases/RELEASE_NOTES_TEMPLATE.md](releases/RELEASE_NOTES_TEMPLATE.md): planned / tested / staging / testnet / main
- [docs/operations/routines.md](operations/routines.md): routine ownership map, not a scheduler

- [docs/releases/2026-11-08-intake-tabletop.md](releases/2026-11-08-intake-tabletop.md): manual dry run of intake, eight scenarios, not a runtime test
